commands.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=22e41166225e47cc14e08c749753e5f111e1f1b7; ACTUAL=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo SOURCE_SHA=$ACTUAL; test "$ACTUAL" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

set -euo pipefail; command -v adb; adb version; adb devices -l; SERIALS=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$COUNT" = "1"; SERIAL=$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | head -n1); MANUFACTURER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.manufacturer | tr -d '\r'); MODEL=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); ANDROID=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.version.release | tr -d '\r'); SDK=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk | tr -d '\r'); ONEUI=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.version.oneui | tr -d '\r'); FINGERPRINT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.fingerprint | tr -d '\r'); echo SERIAL=$SERIAL; echo MANUFACTURER=$MANUFACTURER; echo MODEL=$MODEL; echo ANDROID=$ANDROID SDK=$SDK ONEUI=$ONEUI; echo FINGERPRINT=$FINGERPRINT; test "${MANUFACTURER,,}" = "samsung"; case "$MODEL" in SM-S906*) ;; *) echo "Refusing install: connected device is not a Galaxy S22+ (SM-S906*): $MODEL" >&2; exit 1;; esac
